(a) 0

Name the part of the human eye that controls the amount of light entering it.
questions.solution: Iris (it adjusts the size of the pupil).

questions.text: Study the circuit diagram given below and find the equivalent resistance between points A and B.
questions.solution: The two 6 Ω resistors are in parallel: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/6, so R = 3 Ω. Adding the 2 Ω in series gives 5 Ω.

questions.text: State two differences between arteries and veins.
questions.solution:
1. Arteries carry blood away from the heart; veins carry blood to the heart.
2. Arteries have thick elastic walls; veins have thin walls and valves.

questions.text:
(a) Write the balanced chemical equation for the reaction of zinc with dilute sulphuric acid.
(b) Which gas is evolved? How would you test for it?
questions.solution:
(a) Zn + H₂SO₄ → ZnSO₄ + H₂
(b) Hydrogen gas. A burning splinter brought near it is put out with a 'pop' sound.
